meta.name: Killing Veerappan
meta.description: A master strategist is appointed following Veerappan's unabashed spate of crimes and murders. The official puts in place Operation Cocoon, which involves setting up a network of spies and informers.
meta.slogan: It Took 10 Years To Kill Osama Bin Laden, It Took 20 Years To Kill Veerappan
